name: blog-builder
description: A free, open-source blog that runs on your own Cloudflare account, built on EmDash.

THEME.description: The theme your blog starts with, such as `notebook`. You can switch to any of the 16 themes later in your blog's admin.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long secret code you choose. After deploying, open `https://<your blog>/setup-link?setup=<your code>` to finish setting up. Only someone with the code can become the blog's admin.
